name: Thomas McClung
role: Builder of Medora's billiard hall; later Dawson County deputy sheriff
bio: Thomas McClung won the contract to build Medora's new billiard hall in April 1884. By April 1885 he was serving as deputy sheriff of Dawson County, Montana.

moments.label: Won the contract for the new billiard hall
Serving as Dawson County deputy sheriff

mentions: …lans and specifications are all made and the contract for the new billiard hall has been awarded to Mr. Thos. McClung. A large amount of lumber is here and the building will begin almost immediately.
Several new carpenters have arrived and work on the new billiard hall is being rapidly pushed. Thomas McClung has the contract.
Tom McClung is kept busy as deputy sheriff of Dawson county, Montana.
